test_int_conversion: test the pandas CSV parser integer conversion from float-like strings to integer columns
test_parse_bool: test the pandas CSV parser boolean parsing with custom true and false value mappings
test_parse_integers_above_fp_precision: test the pandas CSV parser correctly reads large integers beyond float64 precision
test_integer_overflow_bug: test the pandas CSV parser handles integer overflow with scientific notation separators
test_int64_overflow: test the pandas CSV parser raises overflow errors for integers exceeding int64 uint64 range with converters
test_int64_uint64_range: test the pandas CSV parser parses values at int64 and uint64 boundaries as integers
test_outside_int64_uint64_range: test the pandas CSV parser parses values outside int64 uint64 range as object dtype
test_numeric_range_too_wide: test the pandas CSV parser casts mixed negative and uint64 values to string dtype
test_integer_precision: test the pandas CSV parser maintains integer precision with custom separators and large values
review_test_ints: review the pandas CSV parser integer test module for edge cases and overflow handling
